description: Return today's NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (today only, no past dates): title, date, image URL, explanation and credit. Use it to share today's picture; for the Sun's activity use solar, for asteroids near Earth use neo_watch. Says available=false instead of inventing a picture when NASA has not answered. Live NASA API through Vigi-Sky.
